mapper.select: SELECT membership_id, tenant_id, subject_id, membership_role, status, permission_version, version, created_at FROM organization_access.tenant_membership WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId} AND status = 'ENABLED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding (tenant_id, membership_id, role_code, bound_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{roleCode}, #{boundAt})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_id = #{membershipId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.membership_permission direct_permission WHERE direct_permission.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND direct_permission.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND direct_permission.permission_code = 'access:manage' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding built_in_binding WHERE built_in_binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND built_in_binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND built_in_binding.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' AND built_in_binding.role_code <> #{revokedRoleCode} UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role_binding custom_binding INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role custom_role ON custom_role.tenant_id = custom_binding.tenant_id AND custom_role.custom_role_id = custom_binding.custom_role_id AND custom_role.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role_permission custom_permission ON custom_permission.custom_role_id = custom_role.custom_role_id AND custom_permission.permission_code = 'access:manage' WHERE custom_binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND custom_binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id )

SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_id <> #{membershipId} AND membership.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.membership_permission direct_permission WHERE direct_permission.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND direct_permission.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND direct_permission.permission_code = 'access:manage' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding built_in_binding WHERE built_in_binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND built_in_binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND built_in_binding.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role_binding custom_binding INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role custom_role ON custom_role.tenant_id = custom_binding.tenant_id AND custom_role.custom_role_id = custom_binding.custom_role_id AND custom_role.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role_permission custom_permission ON custom_permission.custom_role_id = custom_role.custom_role_id AND custom_permission.permission_code = 'access:manage' WHERE custom_binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND custom_binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id )
